in_arabic.name: خُلَت
in_arabic.meaning: to cover, conceal, or wrap up
in_arabic.long_meaning: The name Khulat is derived from the Arabic root 'kh-l-t' which means 'to cover, conceal, or wrap up'. It could be a name given to a child born during a sandstorm or one who is always covered up due to illness or religious reasons.

in_urdu.name: خُلَت
in_urdu.long_meaning: The name Khulat in Urdu translates to 'pharna' which means 'to cover' or 'sar-khaz' which means 'a covered area'. It could be a name given to a child born during a sandstorm or one who is always covered up due to illness or religious reasons.

in_pashto.name: خُلَت
